name: mod_info
summary: The running mod's identity and health: version, pipe name, per-method call counts and times, the game members it reaches, and its cost to the game. Read only.

help.text: pipe_name is the local pipe this game listens on (the server's --pipe), telling which game a server reached when two run on one machine. Lists methods 15 and reflection 10 by default; list_limits keeps more.
help.keys: mod_id, mod_version, assembly_version, informational_version, pipe_name, methods [{method, calls, errors, total_ms, mean_ms, max_ms}], count, reflection [{member, resolved, optional}], missing_count, runtime {uptime_s, world_epoch, request_budget_ms, frames, memory, profiling, ...}.

methods.text: methods: every method the mod answers, {method, calls, errors, total_ms, mean_ms (null before the first call), max_ms}, counted in memory after the mod loaded; main-thread time per request; errors are replies with ok false. The pipe reply envelope of the mod carries elapsed_ms, the main-thread time of a request; MCP tool results do not carry it, so use mean_ms and max_ms here.

reflection.summary: The game members the mod reaches.
reflection.text: reflection [{member, resolved, optional}]: every game member the mod reaches by name. Optional ones belong to other mods such as Terraforming Reloaded and BlueprintMod. missing_count: required members not found; methods that need one answer game_changed.

runtime.summary: What the mod costs the game.
runtime.text: runtime: uptime_s; world_epoch (worlds left after load; leaving one clears IC pauses, job records, print and flight logs); request_budget_ms (main-thread ms per frame for requests, null = unlimited); frames {busy_frames, requests_served, requests_per_frame_mean, requests_per_frame_max, frame_ms, budget_stops, expired}; memory {gc_collections, gc_max_generation, gc_total_memory_bytes, mono_used_bytes, mono_heap_bytes}; methods: the 10 costliest so far (method_count counts all), each {method, calls, errors, main_thread_ms, handler_ms, serialize_ms, queue_wait_ms, reply_bytes}, the last four as {total, mean, max}; profiling, only while the profiling tool is on: {since_s, slow_frame_ms, frame_ms {p50, p95, max}, worst_frame_ms, top [{name, ms}]}, top being the five pieces with the most self time.
